rationale: Exceptional fidelity to Poe's text with near-verbatim narration, all core beats preserved (eye obsession, seven-night surveillance, heartbeat climax, dismemberment, police visit, confession) and no invented plot. Closed cast strictly observed with stable visual descriptions for NARRATOR, OLD MAN, and three named officers. Highly directable via concrete, camera-observable actions and one-beat-per-clip structure; montage handles repetition efficiently. Pacing slightly compressed on the seven nights but tension escalates effectively. Dialogue authentic to source language and period with strong subtext; sound cues are precise and central to the auditory horror, though no explicit score is indicated.
